dialogues.speaker: Iotham
dialogues.text: #Thank you, {NICKNAME}! I want to be a great person just like you, and help those in need just as Rana and you did for me!

dialogues.speaker: Iotham
dialogues.text: #Right, take these Starshrooms, {NICKNAME}. Rana says eating the Starshrooms I picked always lifts her spirits. I hope they can lift your spirits, too!
